subject.title: fix(msteams): read file attachments on Teams channel messages (team GUID + channel fallback + thread-reply URL)

question: Should this PR's automatic non-personal text/html-stub Graph media fallback be accepted for Microsoft Teams channel attachments, or should the channel fix wait for a stricter opt-in/combined fallback shape?
rationale: The code fix is bounded and source-backed, but the fallback changes when existing Teams channel/group messages can trigger Graph reads and may interact with the earlier mention-only false-positive protection.

options.title: Accept the narrowed fallback
options.body: Merge this PR after exact-head checks if maintainers accept best-effort Graph media lookup for non-personal Teams text/html stubs.

options.title: Require an opt-in or stricter gate
options.body: Ask for a config-gated or more specific signal before Graph fetches run for text/html stubs without attachment IDs.

options.title: Reconcile with the group-chat fallback PR
options.body: Pause this PR and combine the channel aadGroupId/reply URL repair with the separate group-chat fallback policy before landing.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed fallback
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after exact-head checks if maintainers accept best-effort Graph media lookup for non-personal Teams text/html stubs.
